core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khabir corresponds to the Arabic form خبير (Arabic root خ ب ر (kh-b-r); خَبِير (Khabīr)). Its core sense is well-informed, aware, expert. Khabir is Arabic خَبِير (Khabīr) 'well-informed, aware, expert', from the root خ ب ر (kh-b-r); it is also one of the names of Allah (الخبير). The source gloss 'The One Informed' is broadly consistent. Same name as khabeer.

urdu.long_meaning: Khabir (خبیر) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم خبیر، باخبر، ماہر ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.long_meaning: Khabir (خبير) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الخبير، العليم، العالم. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: What is the origin of Khabir?
faq.a: Khabir is associated with Arabic. Khabir is Arabic خَبِير (Khabīr) 'well-informed, aware, expert', from the root خ ب ر (kh-b-r); it is also one of the names of Allah (الخبير). The source gloss 'The One Informed' is broadly consistent. Same name as khabeer.
Yes — the underlying form خبير is Arabic.
Khabir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Khabir mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khabir is rendered خبیر and carries the sense خبیر، باخبر، ماہر.

faq.q: What does Khabir mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khabir is rendered خبیر and carries the sense خبیر، آگاه، کاردان.
A romanized syllable approximation is kha-bir. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khabir?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khabir, khabir. Script forms are خبير, خبیر, ख़बीर.

faq.q: Is Khabir a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
